description: This Swift source file defines an `enum` called WindowPlacement with static methods for calculating window frames and ensuring windows are on-screen within a macOS application using AppKit.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a centered window frame within a specified screen or bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a window frame positioned at the top right of a specified screen or bounds with padding.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a centered window frame within given bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a top-right window frame within bounds with padding.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame(size:anchor:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame positioned below a given anchor rect, with clamping to bounds.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen(window:defaultSize:fallback:)
methods.description: Ensures the window is within visible screen bounds; repositions if necessary.
